cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：简单地；仅仅
cards.example_en: I simply want a glass of water.

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：完全地
cards.example_en: I totally forgot about the meeting.
cards.example_zh: 我把这次会面忘得一干二净。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：广泛地
cards.example_en: Football is widely played in our school.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校踢足球的人很多。

cards.example_en: Ms Lee wrote one kind comment beside my messy diagram.
cards.example_zh: 李老师在我凌乱的图旁边写了一句善意的评论。

cards.example_en: Addition is easier for me than long division.
cards.example_zh: 对我来说，加法比长除法容易。

cards.example_en: His explanation of the graph used one simple story about rainfall.
cards.example_zh: 他对这张图的解释，只用了一个关于降雨的简单故事。

cards.example_en: Health inspection closed the snack bar for two days.
cards.example_zh: 卫生查验让小吃店停业了两天。

cards.example_en: Our mission was to collect books for the village school.
cards.example_zh: 我们的使命是为那所乡村学校募集图书。

cards.example_en: Our town's population grew after the new factory opened.
cards.example_zh: 新工厂开业后，我们镇的人口增加了。

cards.example_en: My sister trains every evening at the music academy.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐每天晚上都在音乐学院训练。

cards.example_en: We can accomplish the group project before Friday's class.
cards.example_zh: 我们可以在周五上课之前完成这个小组项目。

cards.example_en: My alarm clock rings at six thirty.
The train leaves at seven am from the east station.
cards.example_zh: 火车上午七点从东站出发。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：不管怎样
cards.example_en: It was late, but we went anyway.
cards.example_zh: 已经晚了，但我们还是去了。
